title: Web Hosting Plans: Working Out an Auto-Renew Refund Amount
content:
**Working sheet — auto-renew refund amount on Web Hosting Plans**

*The line refunded.* The charge refunded is the plan's most recent auto-renew line, that is, the plan's auto-renew billing line with the latest charge date; its amount, how it was paid, its charge date, its period start and the months it covered are all read from that line.

*The amount.* The auto-renew refund amount is the full amount of that line, rounded half up to the cent.

*Assembly.* A refund this rule books, of a line paid by card or through PayPal returned to that payment method, is the charge less the keep-backs this rule lists. The keep-backs are USD amounts subtracted from the line amount, and the auto-renew refund amount is never below zero.

**Worked example (hypothetical line).** The plan's auto-renew lines are dated 2 May of one year (USD 240.10) and 2 May of the following year (USD 287.64). The most recent is the second; with nothing kept back the refund amount is USD 287.64.

**Assembly illustration (hypothetical keep-backs).** Keep-backs totalling USD 30.15 on that line leave USD 257.49. Keep-backs totalling more than USD 287.64 leave zero, never a negative amount.
